## Commit and environment

Repository commit, OS, Python version, and Lean version if used.

## Command and outcome

Give the exact command, expected result or source certificate, and actual result.
Include the relevant output excerpt; link larger logs if needed. Successful
independent reproductions are welcome too.

## Coverage and remaining question

State which cases or declarations were checked, any skipped steps, and the
smallest next action. Do not include credentials or private environment contents.
